claim: In the viewer an outer box-shadow on an element with no background colour paints the element's own box black; a blurred outer box-shadow and an outer box-shadow with an alpha colour composite against black (a black halo around the blur, a darkened alpha shadow). The library therefore uses only hard-edged outer shadows with opaque colours on elements that have a background (the plate's ring shadows, the tooltip), keeps inset shadows (with alpha or not) and lint rule 6 refuses blur and outer alpha shadows. Open: whether J30's D3D9 render interface behaves the same (it ports the same RmlUi layer code); J32's parity check and J35 should try a blurred shadow before the rule is relaxed
notes: J32 run 20261106_j32pc: a viewer bug, not a limit of the recipe (viewer.clear_order_layers); the game draws these shadows correctly (rmlui63.recipe.outer_shadow)
